children: Super Micro Computer Inc. (SMCI, Financials) has appointed Mark Long as its new chief financial officer at a delicate time for the AI server maker.
Long formerly was chief financial officer and chief strategy officer of Western Digital, where he managed financial management, investor relations and corporate strategy.
For Super Micro, the hiring is about more than just filling a place at the executive table.

The corporation has been mired in criticism over financial reporting, governance and internal controls for the past many years. It was a close call to meet an SEC reporting deadline in 2025 after auditor resignations put it at risk of being delisted from Nasdaq.
That background implies investors are likely to assess Long largely on whether he can restore confidence in the company's financial operations.

The time also arises as Super Micro remains firmly connected to the AI infrastructure expansion. Its servers are used to operate high-performance CPUs in data centers, providing it considerable exposure to one of the fastest expanding technological industries.
Shares plummeted roughly 6% Thursday, although the article indicated the selloff was largely tied to the overall selloff in AI equities and not the CFO news.
The next thing to monitor will be if Long can enhance financial discipline and investor trust as Super Micro continues to grow its AI server business.

title: Super Micro Names Former Western Digital Executive Mark Long CFO
